title: Stopgap transportation funding fails to advance in Senate
summary: A Senate reconciliation bill would cut public transit funding by 20% and passenger rail funding by 83%. Without a bill, another government shutdown looms.

title: Single-staircase reforms aim to boost middle-scale housing in Michigan
summary: The reforms will make smaller-scale apartment buildings cheaper and easier to build, officials say.

title: $20B in federal climate grants unblocked by appeals court
summary: A divided court rejected the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s attempt to reclaim Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund grants “based solely on a policy disagreement” with the Inflation Reduction Act.

title: Public benefits of land use don’t outweigh local zoning, New Jersey Supreme Court says
summary: The ruling was hailed by the state’s municipal league as a major win for local authority.

title: NYC building failure triggered citywide inspection campaign
summary: Inspectors expanded scrutiny across multiple office-to-residential projects after a high-profile beam failure, highlighting the challenges of converting aging buildings to housing.

title: Smaller communities wary of proposed federal grant overhaul
summary: The changes could discourage small cities from applying for federal funding and increase municipal budget uncertainty, College Park, Georgia, Mayor Bianca Motley Broom says.

title: LA homelessness ticks up after two years of declines
summary: Funding cuts in Los Angeles city and county are the primary cause for increased homelessness this year, local agencies say.

title: High-speed trains would get new noise regulations in FRA proposal
summary: The update “will remove a major obstacle” to future U.S. high-speed rail projects, the Federal Railroad Administrator said.

title: 30+ water utility cyberattacks expose a vulnerability across US cities
summary: Attackers remotely accessed industrial controllers at water systems in seven states. The campaign suggests a common weakness utilities everywhere should address, experts warn.
